About Obby +1 Double Jump

Jump, dash, and race against others in this fast-paced platformer! Conquer 10+ thrilling stages to earn Wins and unlock epic custom trails and skins—including the legendary Tung-Tung-Tung Sahur. Do you have what it takes to master the obby?

How to play
